title: Info Label
features:
Core HUD Features

Geometry Dash–style on-screen debug HUD

Toggleable visibility (F3)

Compact mode and full mode switch

RichText formatting with section headers

Monospaced font optimized for readability

Non-resetting GUI (persists on respawn)

Performance Monitoring

Real-time FPS counter

Average frame time (ms)

FPS minimum and maximum tracking (last interval)

Client memory usage (MB)

Network incoming bandwidth (Kbps)

Network outgoing bandwidth (Kbps)

Session uptime tracking

Server Diagnostics

Estimated server FPS

Server memory usage

Server heartbeat time (ms)

Player count and max players

Player State & Gameplay

Humanoid state detection (Running, Jumping, Falling, etc.)

Grounded state detection (Humanoid state + raycast fallback)

Current health and max health

Death counter

Alive time since last respawn

WalkSpeed and JumpPower display

Movement & Physics

Real horizontal velocity using AssemblyLinearVelocity

Smoothed velocity calculation via rolling average

Exact world position (X, Y, Z)

Gravity value from Workspace

Input Monitoring

Real-time movement key detection

W, A, S, D

Space

Shift

Control

Clean input display (movement-only focus)

Multiplayer Awareness

Nearest player detection

Distance to nearest player (studs)

Directional indicator (N, NE, E, etc.)

Real-time updates while players move

Mouse & World Inspection

Toggleable mouse inspection mode (F10)

Mouse target detection

Target name, class, material

Target size and world position

Full instance path display

Separate mouse info panel

Highlight applied to hovered parts

Beam rendered from player to mouse target

X-Ray Mode

Toggleable X-Ray mode (F8)

Highlight rendering on all other players

World geometry transparency override

Original transparency preservation and restoration

Automatic handling for players joining mid-session

Utility Tools

Copy player position to clipboard (C)

Copy mouse target instance path to clipboard (V)

On-screen copy confirmation notification

Executor-compatible clipboard handling

System & Device Info

Platform detection (PC, Console, Mobile)

Graphics quality level

Screen resolution detection

Camera Field of View (FOV)

Time of day from Lighting

Game & Account Info

Place ID display

Job ID display

User ID display

Account age in days

Stability & Safety

Extensive use of protected calls (pcall)

Graceful handling of missing characters or components

Automatic cleanup of temporary instances

Safe toggling of all optional systems

Input Controls Summary

F3: Toggle HUD visibility

F8: Toggle X-Ray mode

F10: Toggle mouse inspection

B: Toggle compact mode

C: Copy player position

V: Copy mouse target path

Credits to whom they are due
